component.name: Gleem Imager
component.summary: Write Gleem IRL images to SD cards

description.p: Gleem Imager writes the Gleem IRL image for the Orange Pi 5 Plus and the Raspberry Pi to an SD card. It downloads the list of current images from get.gleem.gg, writes the chosen one straight to the card and verifies it.
Gleem Imager is based on Raspberry Pi Imager by Raspberry Pi Ltd and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Raspberry Pi Ltd.
